home.title: Minigames | Daily Logic Puzzles
home.description: Small daily logic puzzles. A new board for every game each day, with streaks, hints and unlimited practice.

games.zip: Draw one path through every cell, passing the numbers in order. A new board every day, plus unlimited practice.
games.patches: Cover the grid with rectangles, one clue each. A new board every day, plus unlimited practice.
games.chess: Solve a chess tactic from a generated game: give mate, win material or save the position, with a coach who explains every move. A new puzzle every day, plus unlimited practice.
games.queens: Place one queen in every row, column and coloured region so that no two queens touch. A new board every day, plus unlimited practice.
games.sumbreak: Merge equal neighbours into their sum, in the right order, until a single tile is left. A new board every day, plus unlimited practice.
games.wend: Trace the hidden words through neighbouring letters until every letter is used. A new themed board every day, in English or Portuguese, plus unlimited practice.
games.termo: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries, or two and four words at once. A new word every day, in English or Portuguese, plus unlimited practice.

room.title: Challenge room
room.description: A race through the same puzzles, against friends, live.

roomNew.title: Challenge friends
roomNew.description: Open a room, pick the puzzles and send the link. Everyone gets the same boards and races to finish them.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: Who solved today's daily puzzles fastest, and who scored the most this week.
